# Infinity Miner

**Category:** World  
**Aliases:** Infinity Miner

## What it does

Allows you to essentially mine forever by mining repair blocks when the durability gets low. Needs a mending pickaxe.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://github.com/MeteorDevelopment/meteor-client/blob/e3a2e77967629d216e127b5ceecf71fb15f9d2e5/src/main/java/meteordevelopment/meteorclient/systems/modules/world/InfinityMiner.java). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
